run_16_sigkill_oom.symptom: Fresh Railway run terminated around Chapter 11: 'Worker (pid:3) was sent SIGKILL! Perhaps out of memory?' (gunicorn message)
run_16_sigkill_oom.verdict: CONFIRMED OOM (kernel OOM-killer), not a gunicorn guess
proof_from_code: _RENDER_CACHE was an unbounded module-global dict: every render_page_png call stored a full-page PIL RGB image (~6.3 MB at 150 dpi letter).

Call sites that render per page: window_has_question_content/page_has_question_content (Q-activation OCR on every S-window), claim_block_images_ocr (L2 OCR geometry), full_page_vision_ownership (L3 page + 2 context pages per call).
The PAY run's ledger shows ~150 pages rendered by chapter 11 (pages 3..160) -> ~950 MB held permanently; Railway free containers have 512 MB -> OOM-kill at chapter 11 matches the timeline exactly.
full_page_vision_ownership MUTATED the cached render (ImageDraw.Draw on the cached object) so re-renders returned highlighted copies and the drawn image stayed in memory.
PyMuPDF doc objects never explicitly closed; pdftoppm temp dirs (with a ~6 MB PNG each) leaked on disk.
fixes: Bounded LRU render cache: _RENDER_CACHE_MAX=10 (~65 MB worst case at 150 dpi) with oldest-eviction; render_cache_size()/clear_render_cache() helpers.
clear_render_cache() + gc.collect() at chapter end + peak-RSS telemetry line ([MEM] chapter N committed: peak RSS X MB) so Railway logs show memory without waiting for SIGKILL.
full_page_vision_ownership draws on page_img.copy() -- the cache keeps the clean render.
render_page_png closes the PyMuPDF doc in finally and removes the pdftoppm temp dir after loading.

Resume safety: questions.jsonl is now rewritten ATOMICALLY per chapter (rewrite_questions_file: drop this chapter's old rows, append fresh, dedupe keep-LAST by id, os.replace). main()/app.py/test_v2_chapter.py pass the PATH instead of an append handle. A worker death at ANY point leaves the file = last committed chapter; a resume can never duplicate records (old append-mode deduped only at the end of a full book -> mid-book deaths left duplicates).
run_16_sigkill_oom.resume_verification: process_pdf skips chapters in progress['chapters_done'] (saved AFTER the atomic rewrite); a death between rewrite and save_state re-runs the chapter which REPLACES its rows (no dup); a death after save_state skips it. Both paths are duplication-free.
